build_LLMEngine_from_engine_args: build an LLMEngine instance from EngineArgs with model, tokenizer, and distributed config
create_LLMEngine_from_vllm_config: create an LLMEngine instance from a VllmConfig with optional stat loggers and usage context
run_LLMEngine_step: run the engine step method to get processed RequestOutput or PoolingRequestOutput list
test_LLMEngine_add_request: test adding a request to the engine with a prompt, SamplingParams, and optional LoRA request
refactor_LLMEngine_lora: refactor the LLMEngine to add, remove, list, and pin LoRA adapters dynamically
